title: Marked invariant algebras descend to a polynomial cylinder
statement:
Let $V$ be a field or a complete discrete valuation ring, let $r\geq1$, and let $B$ be a complete Noetherian normal local domain. Suppose $V\subseteq B$ is a coefficient subring inducing an isomorphism on residue fields and there is an injective module-finite local map $V[[t_1,\ldots,t_r]]\to B$. Let a finite group $H$, of order invertible in $V$, act by local automorphisms on $B$ and on $V$, compatibly with this map and fixing each variable. If $V$ is a field, assume $H$ is trivial. Assume that $\Lambda=V^H$ is a field or a complete discrete valuation ring respectively. Assume also that for some $f\in V[[t_1,\ldots,t_r]]$ with nonzero reduction modulo $\mathfrak m_V$, the finite map is etale after inverting $f$. Set $A_0=B^H$. Given any finite family of ideals $I_1,\ldots,I_s\subseteq A_0$, there exist an $H$-equivariant change of formal coordinates $u_1,\ldots,u_r$ fixing $V$, the complete coefficient ring $D=\Lambda[[u_1,\ldots,u_{r-1}]]$, a finite type $D[T]$-algebra $C$, a maximal ideal $\mathfrak n\subset C$ lying over $(\mathfrak m_D,T)$, and ideals $J_1,\ldots,J_s\subseteq C$ with an isomorphism
$$\widehat{C_{\mathfrak n}}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_0$$
as $D$-algebras, carrying $J_i\widehat{C_{\mathfrak n}}$ onto $I_i$. The map $D\to A_0$ here is the inclusion defined by the invariant formal coordinates. The ring map $D[T]\to C$ is quasi-finite: it is finite type and its fibres are finite spectra with finite residue-field extensions. The residue field $C/\mathfrak n$ is finite over $D/\mathfrak m_D$. If $s=0$ the same assertion holds without ideals; the ideals $0$ and $A_0$ are allowed.

Normal means integrally closed domain, and the fixed subring consists of elements fixed by every element of $H$. Use [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], [def-weil-pbc-ring-map-quasi-finite-at-prime] for the indicated ring notions. The hat denotes completion for powers of the maximal ideal of the specified local ring.

source.place: V 2.2.1--2.2.8 and 3.2.2--3.2.4, pp.65--68: Weierstrass change of coordinates, Elkik descent to the henselian cylinder, descent of primary ideals, then finite-presentation descent to a pointed etale neighbourhood of the polynomial cylinder. The quasi-finite map is the composite of a finite algebra and that etale neighbourhood. This formulation takes the equivariant finite formal presentation as a hypothesis; it does not construct a cover of an arbitrary complete local ring.
